name: solve-lite
description: Local-first bounded decision routing for ordinary Codex sessions through one shared, CoreML-native runtime with four tiny heads. Installation is automatic and requires no model path or ML environment.

interface.longDescription: Routes ordinary Codex prompts through the local Solve Lite parent router and exposes evidence-backed percentages, token status, and reward settlement. One hash-pinned shared CoreML runtime serves every specialist route; the Codex adapter remains thin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Solve Lite automatically for this ordinary Codex session.
